Each time it startles my child who then gets quiet and runs to whispers to me what it said. This is inappropriate, and it’s always in the coloring app. It puts of red flags big time. It may be other random places as well, but that’s where my child likes the most on the app.

I am writing this review and deleting the app. I strongly warn against it.
